xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: The Company had received an assessment order amounting to Rs. 35,20,98,430/- under section 143(3) of Income Tax Act, 1961, pertaining to AY 2022-23, wherein certain disallowances have been affected by the Assessing Officer. Further, a rectification order under section 154 read with section 143(3) of the Income Tax Act, 1961 had been passed by the Office of the Assistant Commissioner of Income Tax on 2nd May, 2025 wherein the aforesaid demand had been deleted/adjusted by the said authority. However, an Appeal was filed for the demand raised by the Assessing Officer in the assessment order amounting to Rs. 35,20,98,430/-. The same was pending before the Commissioner of Income Tax (Appeals).
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: The Appeal is still pending before Commissioner of Income Tax (Appeals).
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs:
Consequent to Hon’ble Supreme Court’s Order dated 23rd October 2024 vide which it had upheld the State’s authority to levy import/export fees on denatured alcohol, the Excise Department of Uttar Pradesh had reinstated import/export fees on denatured alcohol by revoking its earlier Order of 2018 which had suspended import/export fees on denatured alcohol. Accordingly, the Assistant Excise Commissioner of Uttar Pradesh had imposed charges retrospectively, covering the period from FY 2019-2020 upto 15.07.2025. The Company had stated that it will be going through appropriate forums for evaluating legal recourse to be taken in the above-mentioned matter.
Further, the Uttar Pradesh Sugar Mills Association (UPSMA) has filed a writ petition before the Hon’ble High Court of Judicature at Allahabad against the aforesaid matter, which is currently pending adjudication.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: The Writ Petition filed before the High Court of Judicature at Allahabad is still pending before the court.
